posts.author: matsnil
posts.text: · The bull case for oil from the Saudi Aramco conference call yesterday: "Since disruptions began, the global market has lost over 3 billion barrels of liquid supply. Alternative flows including export via our East-West pipeline and strategic petroleum reserve releases have narrowed the cumulative deficit to around 2 billion barrels. The remaining gap was balanced by demand management and substantial withdrawals from commercial inventories. While these actions have bought time, they are not a permanent solution." posts.author: Oxion
posts.text: – Hvis jeg skulle kjøpt én oljeaksje i dag, ville jeg valgt Panoro Energy, sier Christoffer Bachke  Clarksons har kjøp og et kursmål på 58 kroner. Fra aksjekursen på 30,15 kroner, tilsvarer det en oppside på rundt 90 prosent. – Markedet overser På Clarksons’ estimater prises Panoro til under fire ganger forventet inntjening i 2027 og under tre ganger i 2028, basert på en oljepris på 75 dollar fatet.
